chunks: Then cast him to be burnt in Hell;

key_terms.الْجَحِيمَ: Hellfire, specifically referring to the deepest or most intense part of Hell
key_terms.صَلُّوهُ: Cast him to be burnt / Make him taste the fire

ai.seo_question: What is the command given regarding the disbeliever in Hell?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this imperative command (Amr) to cast the disbeliever into Hellfire underscores the finality of divine judgment for those who persist in rejection. It highlights the transition from worldly denial to eternal retribution, serving as a stark reminder of the consequences of rejecting the truth (Haqq).
